services.desc: Join an experienced birder and photographer for a half day guided trip to the Louisiana Marsh and swamp under an hour from downtown New Orleans. We will travel by motor boat out into the estuary to search for wading birds, coastal sea birds, and smaller migratory birds that frequent the ecosystems of Louisiana. This trip generally starts with an early morning sunrise launch or mid afternoon start leading up to sunset.
